text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black takes first place in the Osaka Hai, defeating Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio are among those watching from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond can feel Kitasan Black's leap in strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same, she's determined to win next time. The two promise to face off again at the spring Tenno Sho.
